meta.name: performing-api-rate-limiting-bypass
meta.description: Tests API rate limiting implementations for bypass vulnerabilities by manipulating request headers, IP addresses, HTTP methods, API versions, and encoding schemes to circumvent request throttling controls. The tester identifies rate limit headers, determines enforcement mechanisms, and attempts bypasses including X-Forwarded-For spoofing, parameter pollution, case variation, and endpoint path manipulation. Maps to OWASP API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption. Activates for requests involving rate limit bypass, API throttling evasion, brute force protection testing, or API abuse prevention assessment.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估API限流的安全性。
copy.tagline_en: Test API rate limiting for bypass vulnerabilities.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会发送大量请求测试API的速率限制能否被绕过，比如通过伪造IP头、改变URL路径、切换HTTP方法或内容类型等方式，并报告哪些方法有效。
howto.when: 当你要求测试API的速率限制是否可以绕过、规避节流或评估暴力破解防护时触发。

say.text: 测试这个登录接口的速率限制能否绕过。
say.note: Claude会执行脚本尝试多种绕过技术。

say.text: 尝试用X-Forwarded-For头绕过速率限制。
say.note: Claude会发送带伪造IP头的请求。

say.text: 用参数污染测试速率限制是否有效。
say.note: Claude会在每个请求添加随机参数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sends a high volume of requests to test if API rate limiting can be bypassed via methods like IP header spoofing, URL path variation, HTTP method switching, or content type changes, and reports which techniques work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to test if API rate limits can be bypassed, throttle evasion, or brute-force protection effectiveness.

say_en.text: Test if rate limiting on this login endpoint can be bypassed.
say_en.note: Claude runs scripts trying multiple bypass techniques.

say_en.text: Try bypassing rate limits using X-Forwarded-For spoofing.
say_en.note: Claude sends requests with forged IP headers.

say_en.text: Use parameter pollution to bypass rate limits.
say_en.note: Claude appends random parameters to each request.
